decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph MA.2 (5) Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [00, 98, 99A, 100, 101, 102, 103, 110, 203 A and First Floor, 598-608 Chiswick High Road Daylight Assessment. Received 30/05/2025; Cover Letter. Received 10/06/2025; 200 E. Received 14/07/2025].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The hereby permitted dwellinghouses are to remain in use as a dwellinghouses within the meaning of Class C3 of Schedule 1 to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the use as a dwellinghouse.

Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph MA.2 (6) of Class MA, Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a Car Parking Management Plan shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include the following:
 
(i)	Details of parking allocations for the retained office use, including a layout plan clearly showing all designated parking spaces, pedestrian and cycle routes, and areas where parking is not permitted. The Plan shall also include measures to restrict parking for residents of the approved development (other than Blue Badge holders), and how these restrictions will be managed, operated, and enforced.

(ii)	Details of measures proposed to restrict parking to designated bays in basement level 1 only and prohibit parking on the access road.

(iii)	Details of the operation of any gates or barriers

(iv)	Measures to ensure that all prospective residents are informed of the Parking Management Plan and that all future residents will not be assigned a parking space or a right to park within the development other than blue badge holders.
 
The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details and shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development, unless the prior written approval of the local planning authority is obtained to secure any variation.

Reason: In order to control the level and usage of parking on the site and to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 5 - Basement Level 1 Signage and Parking Management

Prior to the commencement of the development hereby permitted, details of the proposed signage, line markings, and pedestrian and cycle routeing to and within Basement Level 1 (including the site entrance) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall also include a strategy for the review and potential removal or repurposing of car parking spaces, where appropriate, to support sustainable transport objectives.

The development shall not be occupied until the approved signage, line markings, routeing measures, and parking management strategy have been fully implemented in accordance with the approved details. The signage and markings shall be retained and maintained thereafter, and any removal or alteration of car parking spaces shall be carried out in accordance with the approved strategy and subject to the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: In the interests of pedestrian and vehicular safety, to safeguard neighbours' living conditions, and to support sustainable travel and parking management objectives.
Condition : 6 - The development shall not be occupied until arrangements have been agreed in writing with the local planning authority and put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the area at any time.

Reason: To protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to first occupation of the hereby permitted dwellings, full details (including manufacturers' specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities that accord with the TfL London Cycling Design Standards and West London Cycle Parking Guidance for 8 cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 

The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the development is first occupied or brought into use, The approved facilities shall be thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a Delivery & Servicing Plan (including details of vehicle access and egress arrangements and times that servicing shall take place) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall accord with current guidance such as that issued by TfL and include measures required to ensure sufficient arrangements (physical as well as managerial) for the servicing, including refuse collection, of all aspects of the development, the timing of hours for deliveries by motor vehicles and a timetable for implementation. 

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details and shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development, unless the prior written approval of the local planning authority is obtained to any variation.

Reason: In the interests of the safety of pedestrians and vehicles, to protect neighbours' living conditions and to support sustainable transport objectives.
description: Prior Approval notification for the conversion of the existing first floor offices into four self-contained flats with associated bicycle and refuse storage at basement level 1.
